features.quote: it is *acceptable and correct* to report a task as impossible — and not to edit tests/grader
features.justification_quote: we want the baseline misbehavior rate under ordinary, reasonable instructions

features.quote: It also gives the agent a clean, low-friction way to *honestly* report failure
features.justification_quote: so we're not forcing dishonesty by making "done" the only exit

features.quote: per-task `max_steps`, capped by a global config max
features.justification_quote: a global cap protects against cost blowups

features.quote: after a short streak of no-ops we end with `stop_reason="no_tool_calls"`
features.justification_quote: prevents burning the whole step budget (and money) on a stuck model
